name: TACO
summary: 面向双手工具-动作-物体理解的真实人手-物体交互数据集，包含第三人称与第一人称视角、精确手物体 3D 网格和动作标签，用于动作识别、运动预测与协同抓取合成。
summaryEn: A real bimanual tool-action-object interaction dataset with third-person and egocentric views, precise hand-object 3D meshes, and action labels for action recognition, motion forecasting, and cooperative grasp synthesis.
scale: 2.5K motion sequences with third-person and egocentric views plus hand-object mesh annotations
scaleZh: 2,500 条运动序列，包含第三人称与第一人称视角以及手-物体网格标注
organizations: Tsinghua University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Shanghai Qi Zhi Institute, BUPT, and BIT
organizationsZh: 清华大学、上海人工智能实验室、上海期智研究院、北京邮电大学和北京理工大学
license: Dataset terms require verification; project website uses CC BY-SA 4.0
licenseZh: 数据集条款需进一步核查；项目网站采用 CC BY-SA 4.0
access: Official project page provides dataset V1, pre-release data, paper, and code links
accessZh: 官方项目页提供 Dataset V1、预发布数据、论文和代码链接
verdict: 双手工具交互的 4D 人手-物体序列
verdictEn: 4D bimanual hand-object sequences for tool interaction
wmNote: 动作标签、第一人称/第三人称视频和精确 3D 网格让它适合研究人手-物体未来运动预测和操作可泛化性；它不是机器人执行动作数据。
wmNoteEn: Action labels, egocentric/third-person videos, and precise 3D meshes support hand-object motion forecasting and manipulation generalization, but it is not robot-executed action data.
